title: fix(objectql)!: the in-process engine refuses an empty projection, as every published declaration does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8uHuGurhTsusng7ZupVVm1)_

Fixes #27008

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` (Field Selection) says an empty `fields` is refused on the data API and by `engine.find()` / `findOne()`, top level and `expand` alike; `skills/**` teaches `fields` only as a non-empty list and needs no change

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：引擎进程内读入口 `ObjectQL.find` / `findOne` 遇到空投影 `fields: []`（以及任意层 `expand` 条目里的 `fields: []`）时直接拒绝，答 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`，与 REST 门对 `select: []` 的回答相同；措辞直接取自 spec 声明 `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields`（"Name at least one field"），不另写一份。
- **为什么改**：HTTP 门与所有已发布的投影声明都已拒绝空投影，唯独进程内引擎把 `[]` 当成"不投影"，插件、钩子、流程误传空列表时会悄悄拿回全部列（含 owner、组织、审计列）。一条规则：空投影被拒，永不读作全部列。
- **风险与回滚**：低。仓内非测试调用方 0 个传空投影；不传 `fields` 仍读全部列，非空投影照旧。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/empty-projection-door.ts`（拒绝本体与 expand 递归）；`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 两处入口调用；`packages/objectql/src/engine-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts`，预期 10/10 通过；在 `main` 上同文件 6 条失败（`find`/`findOne`/系统上下文/expand 两层/REST 对等）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/objectql/src/empty-projection-door.ts` (new) holds `assertProjectionNamesAField`, called at the entry of `ObjectQL.find` and `ObjectQL.findOne`, right after the option-key gate and before any driver read:

| Read | `main` | This head |
|---|---|---|
| `find(obj, { fields: [] })` | every column, owner / organization / audit included, no error | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, no driver read |
| `findOne(obj, { where, fields: [] })` | every column | refused the same way |
| `find(obj, { fields: [], context: { isSystem: true } })` | every column | refused: the rule is about the shape, not the caller |
| `expand: { rel: { fields: [] } }`, at any depth | the related record's every column | refused at the entry, naming the path (`expand['rel'].fields`) |
| `fields` absent, or `null` | every column | unchanged |
| `fields: ['title']` | projects | unchanged |

- **The declarations' words, not a copy.** The sentence's remedy is read off the published schema, `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.shape.fields.safeParse([])`, whose issue message is the spec's `PROJECTION_NAMES_NO_FIELD` ("Name at least one field"). The constant stays module-private in `data-engine.zod.ts`; no spec change.
- **The doors' answer.** The error carries `status: 400` and `code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`, the shape `projectionFieldsValue` throws at the HTTP doors, so `mapDataError` serves both callers the same status and code. The test pins it against `findData({ query: { select: [] } })` on the same engine.
- **Why `expand` is judged at the entry.** An entry's projection is forwarded to the related object's own `find`, which now refuses it, but `expandRelatedRecords` catches a sub-read failure and keeps the bare foreign key. A refusal raised only there would reach the caller as a silently unexpanded field. Judged at the parent's entry, it reaches the caller as a refusal.
- **Family measured.** `count` and `aggregate` take no projection (`fields` is not in `ENGINE_COUNT_OPTION_KEYS` / `ENGINE_AGGREGATE_OPTION_KEYS`; the key gate refuses it). `DataEngineVectorFindRequestSchema` has no engine implementation (`vectorFind` is declared in `spec/contracts` only). The scoped repository's `find` / `findOne` delegate to the engine's.
- `engine.ts` gains 5 lines (an import and the two calls); the body lives in its own module, in the direction of the #25522 split.

## Why

Card #27008, triage `6458590093`: "the engine refuses an empty projection with the declarations' own refusal. One rule (#26811's line: 'an empty projection is refused, never read as every column')." #26817, #26909 and #26954 (PR #27007) made every published declaration of a read's projection refuse `[]`. The in-process engine never parses its options with those schemas, and its projection guards ran only when `ast.fields.length > 0`, so the empty list reached the driver and every driver served it as no projection.

## Tests

New `packages/objectql/src/engine-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts`, 10 cases, on a real `ObjectQL` over a driver double that projects exactly (an empty list answers every column, as `SqlDriver` and `InMemoryDriver` do) and records each read:

- Refusals, each asserting `mapDataError`'s `status` 400 and `code` `VALIDATION_ERROR`, the declaration's words in the message, and zero driver reads: `find`, `findOne`, a system-context `find`, an `expand` entry, a second-level `expand` entry.
- Parity: the REST door's `findData({ select: [] })` and the engine's refusal map to the same status and code.
- Controls: absent `fields` reads every column; `fields: null` reads every column; `fields: ['title']` projects on `find` and `findOne`; an `expand` with a named nested projection still expands.

<details><summary>Red on main, green on this head, ablation</summary>

Red leg, the new file against `origin/main` `07d18e69` engine source (before the fix commit):

```
Tests  6 failed | 4 passed (10)   — every refusal case: "expected a refusal, got an answer"
probe on the same base:
  find  fields: []  → [{"id":"t1","title":"Ship","project_id":"p1","owner_id":"usr_1","organization_id":"org_1","created_at":"…"}]
                      driver received fields: []
  findOne fields: [] → the same row, every column
  expand { project_id: { fields: [] } } → project_id: {"id":"p1","name":"Apollo","owner_id":"usr_1","organization_id":"org_1"}
  REST door select: [] → 400 {"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","error":"Query parameter 'select' names no field; got []. …"}
```

This head: `Tests  10 passed (10)`.

Ablation, one leg, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (the test imports `./engine.js`, so the mutation is on the resolved source): the top-level arm of `assertProjectionNamesAField` replaced by a marker; anchor 1 → 0, blob `19c6bcd1` → `45086f3d`. `Tests  4 failed | 6 passed (10)`: the `find`, `findOne`, system-context and REST-parity cases; the two `expand` cases stay green on their own arm. Restored: blob == HEAD (`19c6bcd1`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Caller census, at this head.** Non-test callers across `packages`, `ui`, `examples`, `apps` and `skills` that pass `fields: []` to an engine read: 0. Computed projections handed to `find` / `findOne` (37 call sites by a call-text scan; blind to an options object built away from the call): every one is a non-empty literal or constant, or is guarded non-empty (`summaryKeyColumns.length > 0`). FLS does not rewrite `ast.fields` (it masks rows), and the two middlewares that touch `ast.fields` (approvals' reader-locale labels, audit's served fields) only add columns. One pass-through: the flow `get_record` node hands its authored `cfg.fields` to the engine unchanged (`crud-nodes.ts`), and `GetRecordConfigSchema.fields` is `z.array(z.string()).optional()`, which accepts `[]`. No in-repo flow authors it. Such a node read every column before; it now fails with the engine's refusal (`success: false`, the refusal carried by `refusalCarriedBy`). That answer is loud and deliberate, not a widening; the declaration gap is reported to the seat (see the report).
- **Not changed: an all-unknown projection still reads every column in-process.** `engine.find(obj, { fields: ['nope'] })` drops the unknown plain column (the #7589 tolerance, kept by ruling) and then falls back to `*` when nothing is left: measured at this head, the driver receives no `fields` and every column comes back. The REST door refuses the same request `400 INVALID_FIELD`. This is outside the ruling here (it is not an empty projection from the caller) and touches the #7589 ruling, so it goes to the seat as an open question.
- **`expand`'s nested declaration.** `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.expand` is `z.record(QuerySchema)`, and `QuerySchema.fields` (`query.zod.ts`) is `z.array(FieldNodeSchema).optional()`, which still accepts `[]`. The engine now refuses what that declaration admits. Reported to the seat as a spec follow-up rather than edited here (outside the claim's file surface).
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, as claimed: a shape that read before is refused; nothing is widened. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no authored metadata key is added, removed or re-shaped, and no save or publish door refuses anything new.

## Verification

All at head `2e447bbd` unless a line says otherwise.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql build && typecheck && test` at `26ebfb48`: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 477 passed (477), Tests 8898 passed (8898). The two later commits change only the new suite's driver double; that file at this head: Tests 10 passed (10).
- `pnpm build` (full, at `26ebfb48`; no source file changed after it): VERDICT command-exit 0, Tasks 116 successful, 116 total.
- `eslint . --no-inline-config` scoped to `packages/objectql`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, owed by the narrowing arm): VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 348 passed | 3 skipped (351); Tests 2803 passed | 20 skipped (2823).

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 93 commands for the 5 changed paths, all run at this head. `--ran` reconciliation: "93 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Every one exited 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` ran after `git fetch --depth=1` of its pinned fixture commit; `check:type-check-debt` ran under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0).

The first sweep (at `26ebfb48`) had two reds, both in the new suite's driver double, fixed in `a446baef` and `2e447bbd`: `check:objectql-double-limit` (the double ignored `limit`; it now applies it after the filter) and `check:where-matcher` (an unhandled `$` key was read as a field name; the double now throws on it).

Hand-run beside the derived list: `check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`, `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`, `check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0 each.

</details>

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (scoped to `packages/objectql`; the repo-wide run is CI's).

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
